texte.Déclarez un connecteur vers un outil int: Declare a connector to an internal tool by choosing its category (GRC, ERP or ITSM), giving it a name, and entering the HTTPS URL of its API and, if necessary, an authentication token. “Test” checks actual access to the API. “Synchronise” sends this API content suited to the category: a compliance snapshot for a GRC, a ticket for an ITSM, a governance context for an ERP. Only HTTPS URLs are accepted, and the token is never shown again after saving.

texte.Enregistrez chaque entité couverte par v: Record each entity covered by your deployment, specifying its type: subsidiary, group, scope or site. These entities structure steering across your organisation and are kept server side, linked to your account. Enter a name, choose the type, then “Add”; “Remove” deletes an entity.
texte.Facturation par résultats indexée sur l': Outcome-based billing indexed on reaching verified milestones, across three frameworks: AI Act, GDPR and ISO/IEC #.

The button opens the consolidated compliance index of the three frameworks, where these milestones are tracked, without duplicating the existing module.
texte.Le tableau présente les engagements de s: The table sets out the service commitments by criticality level: handling time and target resolution time. These values are indicative and are specified in your contract. A dedicated CONSEILPREV contact is your lead throughout the deployment.
texte.Le test de connexion vérifie l'accès rée: The connection test checks actual access to the configured API (HTTPS).
